headline: Rent alone makes business difficult... 'rental housing-backed mortgage' gets a lukewarm response
summary: The government offered up to 34 years of financial support to draw sale-focused developers into the 20-year long-term rental market. Developers have given the rental-backed mortgage a lukewarm response, citing rental business difficulties.
why: Housing developers and mortgage financing shape South Korea's construction activity and the supply of residential property.
